description:
## Goal

Define one World-owned, immutable, typed, path-aware input-flow relation for activation keying. The same extracted relation must support the current local-dispatch, forwarded-dispatch, and returned dimensions, and expose the typed callable-use sinks that `fz-kdt.165` will consume later. No dimension may rediscover a different approximation of how an input or call result moves.

## Current defect

The current `forwarded_inputs`, `input_positions`, and `returned_values` scans describe different incomplete graphs:

1. a `LoweredTail::DirectCall` result delivered through its destination is not correlated with the exact callsite and later use, so a discarded result can create false return dependence;
2. reconstructed arguments are not related to the input paths from which their fields came;
3. projected arguments, including protocol-callback forwarding, are not related;
4. expression map/field projection, map reconstruction, dynamic keys, and update overwrite semantics are not one exact typed path algebra;
5. a source-only returned mask loses which callee result path reached which caller result path.

These omissions already mint unbought activation keys or miss required distinctions. They would also make the later callable-identity dimension inherit another approximation.

## Correct model

Publish one immutable per-function input-flow fact derived once from `LoweredBody` plus `EntryDispatch`, or from `ProtocolDispatch` for a callback. Provider boundaries publish the exact empty relation. Equal reproduction preserves the retained fact allocation and generation and wakes nobody.

The durable relation contains only typed semantic endpoints:

- origins are a function input path or one exact `CallSiteId` result path;
- sinks are a function-return path, an exact callsite/callee input path, or a typed callable-use path;
- projection extends the source path and reconstruction extends the destination path;
- composition uses prefix/intersection semantics, not path lengths;
- call results remain correlated by `CallSiteId`, so two calls to one callee never cross-connect;
- relation identity is normalized endpoint/path content with set semantics, not the syntactic route that produced it.

Paths use typed structural selectors. Tuple, list, bitstring, map, and struct paths are represented without display strings, canonical text, source spelling, raw interner order, `ValueId`, or `ControlEntryId` authority. Map and struct fields use exact typed keys. Dynamic map access/update has an explicit conservative any-key/root dependency. Known-key updates exclude overwritten base fields, and the last duplicate write owns its key.

Delivery provenance follows the actual control-flow graph. A direct-call return reaches only its own return or delivered resume; a discarded delivery creates no returned edge. Result paths remain explicit so projecting one returned field does not pull unrelated fields.

The relation is extraction, not a cross-function solver. Current `InputDemand` derivation consumes it for its three dimensions while retaining the existing cone solver temporarily. `fz-kdt.213` replaces only that solver with ordinary reactive per-function formulas and component-wide supplied-position handling. `fz-kdt.165` then consumes the already-extracted callable-use sinks to add the fourth atomic dimension and deletes the body-wide callable Boolean.

## TDD

- A direct tail call records exact root argument mappings and its call-result-to-return path.
- Two callsites to one callee remain isolated; a returned result propagates demand and a delivered/discarded result does not.
- A delivered result projected or reconstructed in its resume retains the exact result and destination paths; unrelated fields do not appear.
- Tuple and list projection/reconstruction compose exact source and destination paths, including negative field/tail controls.
- Map and struct paths distinguish typed keys; dynamic keys are conservative; known-key update overwrite and duplicate-last-write semantics are exact; `MapIndex`, `FieldAccess`, and `RequireMapValue` agree.
- Reachable `AssertSame` aliases paths without conflating mutually exclusive arms.
- Protocol forwarding maps callback paths to implementation paths, ignores absent callbacks, and is invariant to arm order and duplicates.
- Duplicate edges and source/job order reproduce the equal retained fact without a new generation or wake.
- Local extraction remains finite for self and mutual recursion.
- Production-boundary fixtures prove delivered-result, reconstructed-argument, projected protocol-callback, direct-forwarding, and unrelated-field behavior across interpreter, JIT, and build doors with exact activation counts.

## Required deletion

- Delete `ForwardEdge`, `forwarded_inputs`, `input_positions`, `extend_positions`, `returned_values`, and their duplicate construction/projection scans.
- Replace private `DemandPathStep` with the shared typed path algebra used by dispatch subjects and flow extraction.
- Replace bespoke protocol forwarding extraction with the same relation.
- Let the temporary recursion-supply calculation consume the relation rather than rescanning `LoweredBody`; `fz-kdt.213` owns deletion of that private fixpoint.
- Leave no compatibility relation, route-history identity, string/raw-ID ordering, probe, migration test, or temporary telemetry.

## Acceptance

- The current three `InputDemand` dimensions consume one typed path relation; the relation exposes callable-use sinks for the later fourth dimension without changing callable-identity behavior in this ticket.
- Every supported semantic mapping has one normalized identity and one constructor path.
- No dimension-specific forwarding/provenance scan or second relation authority remains.
- Relation equality and iteration are deterministic across entry, arm, source, and job order; equal reproduction does no downstream work.
- Focused keying/protocol/reconstruction/map/list/alias tests, all three target doors, full serial library and fixture matrix, cross-process determinism, formatting, documentation checks, `cargo check`, and strict clippy pass.
- A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the final diff before its one commit and close.

## Boundaries

`fz-kdt.213` owns reactive cross-function convergence and removal of the cone/Kleene machinery. `fz-kdt.165` owns the fourth `InputDemand` component and deletion of `BodyKeying::consumes_callable_identity`. `fz-tfn.42` owns runtime return-payload type/demand. This ticket does not absorb those changes.

comments.text: fz-kdt.199 landed (dd07432db) and names this ticket in return_flow_mask's doc and in type-specialization.md with all three holes. The returned axis is solved over the same forwarding cone as fz-kdt.183's dispatch axis, so it inherits that cone's edge set exactly: a DirectCall dest is ignored (deliver2.fz keys 7 -> 9 for nothing), a RECONSTRUCTED argument is not an edge (hops.fz: outer/2 stays collapsed while inner/2 and mid/2 split, so two keys both publish the join -- 2 executables for 0 precision), and a PROJECTED argument is not an edge (proto_cb.fz, the protocol-callback case). One edge-set improvement serves three axes: 183's dispatch, 199's returned, and fz-kdt.165's planned identity axis on the same walk.

title: Define one exact typed path-aware InputDemand flow relation
